name: Swarm board
description: Share a finding or read messages during an explicitly requested multi-agent run.

function.name: swarm_board
function.description: Share findings, send targeted guidance, ask the coordinator and wait for a reply, or read the shared run board. Updates enter worker context automatically between model rounds. Ask pauses up to 120 seconds; the coordinator must answer with send and reply_to_event_id.

to_task_id.description: Optional task ID to distinguish concurrent tasks owned by the same agent.

reply_to_event_id.description: Question event ID being answered. Required to release a worker waiting after ask.
